name: Grand Hyatt Muscat
positioning: Arabian-architecture hotel in the heart of Muscat, steps from the Arabian Sea, with Hajar mountain views
best_for: Families wanting an infinity pool with a lazy river and a kids' pool
Travelers who want sea or mountain views from a balcony room
Groups wanting a multi-bedroom suite with a kitchen

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Muscat, steps from the Arabian Sea.
Rooms feature contemporary decor with traditional Omani touches.
Rooms have marble baths with a soaking tub, walk-in shower and bidet.
Pool View rooms have partial views of the Gulf of Oman from a private balcony.
Grand Club rooms have views of the Hajar Mountains and the Embassy district.
Grand Club rooms include access to the Grand Club private lounge, serving Continental breakfast, evening drinks and hors d'oeuvres.
The master bedroom of the Crown Suites has a four-poster king bed.
Club Olympus is the hotel's fitness and leisure facility, with a modern gym with cardio and strength-training machines.
The ballroom has 10-foot ceilings, crystal chandeliers and its own grand entrance.
At Sirj Tea Lounge, guests relax beneath silk-draped tents with specialty teas, Arabian coffee and light dishes.
The John Barry lounge has its own private terrace overlooking the hotel's garden and pool and the Arabian Sea.

highlights.text: The pool area has an infinity pool with a lazy river, a jacuzzi, a dedicated kids' pool and a kids' play area.
The hotel has views of the Hajar mountains and is steps away from the Arabian Sea.
The hotel is built in authentic Arabian architecture reflecting Omani culture.
The Royal Suite has a marble bath with a jetted spa tub and sauna, and butler service on request.
Crown Suites have a balcony, living and dining areas, a kitchen and a marble bath with a jetted spa tub.

considerations.text: Muscat International Airport is 19 kilometers from the hotel.
Tuscany, the Italian restaurant, does not allow shorts, sandals or flip-flops.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
